description: Bill of materials for building the fitted rover body for real (the parts tab on the Wiring page): the board, motor driver, every enabled sensor, display, camera and head servo, plus the parts the circuit needs around them (chassis, battery, buck converter, voltage-divider resistors, level shifter …), each with quantity, approximate price in THB and shop links when known, and a plain-text list to copy. `board` switches the board first: "esp32", "uno" or "raspberrypi".
name: get_bom
title: Get parts list
